fields.acceptance: A new run-command-step-output.txtar runs a step echo out1; echo boom >&2; exit 3 and run status --json's detail holds exit 3, boom and out1; a step printing 500 lines keeps only the tail (line 500, not line 1); a passing step's detail stays exit 0; a unit test in internal/run/engine_test.go shows a runner's detail is kept
fields.statement: When a command step exits non-zero, its journal detail keeps exit N followed by the last lines of the step's interleaved stdout and stderr, capped at 20 lines and 2 KiB

fields.acceptance: In run-command-step-output.txtar, run status prints - b (visit 1): fail, then end: exit 3 and an indented boom line under it
fields.statement: rhiza run status shows a failed step's kept output as indented lines under the step's line, and Rex's status line still takes only the first line

fields.acceptance: inbox-list.txtar or run-abandon-failed.txtar gains a run failing at a command step that prints boom; rhiza inbox shows boom indented under the item and inbox --json's detail holds it
fields.statement: The inbox item of a run that failed at a command step shows that step's kept output
